reviews.title: Please avoid this app
reviews.text: This app should not be downloaded by minors, or any in general. At first, the app seems fine, and has cute stickers and keyboards, but after having it for a while, you realize it is very inappropriate. First of all, when you try to access the keyboard, and you click in settings to allow full access, your location, bank account information, photos, and texts are at risk. The developers could at any point just look at our personal information if they wanted to, even if it says, “We promise to not use any personal information.” The second reason why this app is inappropriate for minors are the AI ChatGPT’s. This is a keyboard app! Are we really serious that we are this desperate to get more money to add AI to a game of keyboards, gang? The second I typed “Hi” on the chat bot, my text messages were all from the app, saying “Hey, beautiful,” and “When will you come back to me?😍🥺” This is so inappropriate. It says 4+, and we serious?
